title: Gorgeous glassware with flaws.
text:
Gorgeous glassware with flaws.. These handblown, Mexican themed glasses are beautiful.
 They are colorful - glass sprinkled with confetti. The colors include: red, yellow, blue, white and green.
They are textured and hold about 10oz.  
The set has 6 glasses.
 Unfortunately, because these are handmade/handblown, there are some sharp, rough edges. Basically, there are some areas that just aren’t smooth. For example, on the bottom of all 6 glasses there is a round area that is open and has a sharp edges.

Now, the saving grace: These glasses can be used for a variety of things. Multiple uses. Not only can they be drinking glasses, but they can be used as votives, all you would need to do is add a candle. These would be some pretty pencil/pen holders. They can even be used as a toothbrush holder.

In summary: (1) Appearance - 5 stars. (2) Versatility - 5 stars. (3) Design and Execution - 2 stars.  Overall, 3 stars.

product_metadata.title: FESTMEX Confetti Hand Blown Mexican Drinking Glasses – Traditional Set of 6 Confetti Rock Tumbler Glasses (10 OZ, Confetti)
features: Our Mexican glass are handmade in Mexico by artisans using traditional techniques.
Traditional Mexican Confetti style glassware, these traditional blue rim glasses are the authentic glasses use all over Mexico.
This tumbler can be used to keep your drinks fresh, whether is water, juice, lemonade, cocktails, it will keep your drinks looking good and refreshing.
Each tumbler glass holds 10 oz and is approximately 4 inches tall and 3.15 inches in diameter. These handmade Mexican glassware are made from recycled glass.
Since these glasses are made by hand by artisans there may be a slight variation in size and color.
description: Our Mexican glass is handmade in Mexico by artisans using traditional techniques. These traditional blue rim tumblers are authentic glasses use all over Mexico, and at Mexican parties. This is a set of 6 Confetti tumblers, so you can enjoy it with your family and friends.
